title: JANUS Meta Registry Visitor Doors Index — v1.9 Tranception Research Translation Patch

base_index.rule: Apply this patch on top of v1.8; unchanged doors remain inherited from v1.8.

for: protein language model and variant-effect prediction researchers
reviewers separating coding variation from environmental regulation
readers seeking an uncertainty-aware and child-safe mutation research plan
patches.question: How can Tranception contribute to research on coding variants in stress-regulation and neurodevelopmental proteins without pretending that protein sequence alone explains ADHD, trauma, war exposure, breastfeeding stress, or child outcomes?
patches.answer: Use Tranception as a bounded protein-evidence layer for naturally occurring missense and in-frame indel variants. Report mirror disagreement, retrieval gain, MSA provenance, retrieval-weight sensitivity, model-scale spread, matched controls, and failure against simple baselines. Keep environmental exposure, epigenetic regulation, clinical phenotype, and child protection outside the authority of the protein score.
patches.seal: Score the protein, not the worth or destiny of the child.
A useful model exposes its ablations, uncertainty, controls, provenance, and failure conditions.
Genetic evidence may inform research; it must never replace protection, listening, care, or environmental change.
Protein fitness is not a diagnosis, and a pathway candidate is not a child's biography.

global_boundaries_added: No claim that chronic threat creates the coding variants scored by Tranception.
No claim that a Tranception score predicts ADHD, trauma, intelligence, morality, parenting quality, or a child's future.
No reduction of ADHD to one neurotransmitter pathway or one protein.
No use of protein scores for embryo selection, reproductive decisions, school placement, insurance, custody, or ranking people.
No use of identifiable child, family, pregnancy, or clinical records in a public repository.
No intentional human neurotransmitter or stress-axis gain-of-function design for enhancement or self-experimentation.
No hiding mirror disagreement, retrieval dependence, MSA limitations, or model-scale instability.
No pathway claim without matched controls, baseline comparison, and a predeclared failure condition.
core_seal_added: Score the protein, not the worth or destiny of the child.
Sequence variation is one layer; chronic threat, regulation, caregiving, and safety are different layers.
A protein language model may prioritize uncertainty; it does not pronounce a diagnosis.
The adult must arrive before chronic danger forces the child to become their own armor.
Research serves life when it makes uncertainty visible and protection stronger.
